360:t_028:1.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$マリーダ$$ is watching. We can't afford to botch this.」

360:t_028:2.en:
$$フラスト$$
「Understood. Let's show them the pride of the $$ガランシェール$$ crew!」

360:t_100:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$! With this $$ローゼン・ズール$$, I won't lose to your Gundam even in raw power!」

360:t_100:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「This is Captain $$アンジェロ$$'s hostility...!」

360:t_100:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Prepare yourself! I'll rip off your arms and legs, crush your head, leave only the cockpit, and take you to the Colonel!」

360:t_100:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「This is dangerous...! If you keep fighting like this, the machine will end up swallowing you!」

360:t_101:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If that's what you want...」

360:t_101:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's not it, $$ギュネイ$$! I'm taking you on to put a stop to your senseless fight!」

360:t_102:0.en:
$$クェス$$
「You hardheaded fool, $$ギュネイ$$! If you want to fight the Colonel and $$カミーユ$$ that badly, you'll have to beat me first!」

360:t_102:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「No choice, then...! I'm coming through, $$クェス$$!」

360:t_102:2.en:
$$クェス$$
「Try it if you can! I'm not about to lose to a wishy-washy guy like you!」

360:t_103:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Today I'll finally surpass you, Colonel!」

360:t_103:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「I still have things left to do myself! I can't be what you hope for!」

360:t_103:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll rip that mask of composure right off, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

360:t_104:1.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
(...I haven't forgotten... But right now...)

360:t_104:3.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...Attack! Shoot down anyone who comes near that spaceship, one after another!」

360:t_105:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I don't know what's right, or what I should do...)

360:t_105:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
(But I'll fight once more... to protect something... someone...!)

360:t_106:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「You look happy, $$姫$$. Want to make up with Puppy now that you have the chance?」

360:t_106:2.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Give me a break! ...But, well... for now I'll just wait and see how it goes...」

360:t_106:5.en:
$$マリ$$
「Yeah, yeah. It's the same every time, but take your anger out on the enemy.」

360:t_107:1.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(You too have cast aside your hatred. By touching the light in people's hearts...)
